'''2001 Victorian State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Victoria, Australia in 2001.<ref name="dt-15931">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15931 TRM Luca Style (State Championship Deck)], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 13 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15931/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15931/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 6 May 2001<ref name="tr-d2292" />
* '''Site:''' Victoria, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Daniel Robertson]]<ref name="tr-d2292" />
The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Costanzo took his Light Throne Room deck to the Victorian State Championships in Melbourne, where it won all its games, beating an old-school Careful Planning deck, Brangus and a Dark Surgeon Agents Of Black Sun deck. At the event it ran Major Haash'n in place of the posted Alter.<ref name="dt-15931" />
